services.name: Kayak Rentals
services.desc: Kayaks are rented out by the hour, for a half day or a full day. We have multiple single kayaks and two double kayaks. Explore the river with friends, family, or take a solo trip. Go bird watching, fishing, exploring, or swimming. You are welcome to bring a cooler, food, fishing poles (must have valid fishing license), and swim suits. We provide all life jackets and paddles. Don't forget your sunblock/hats/sunglasses! blurb: Red Beard Boats offers captained boat rentals including pontoon boats, ski boats for wakeboarding and waterskiing, kayaks, and stand-up paddle boards. They operate on Lake Placid in Seguin, TX and travel to Lake Dunlap in New Braunfels, TX as needed. All rentals are captained so guests can relax and enjoy the water.
